content.text: CH 5: ENHANCEMENT (UPGRADING YOUR GEAR)
A - GROWTH
This is your general Gear enhancing system consistent with just about every Korean MMO where you simply spend Kinah and Enhance Stones or Amplify Stones to + up your gear.
Enhance Stones are obtained through a lot of different sources and content. These are used until +15 or +20
Amplify Stones are obtained by Substance Morphing Amplify Fragments with Enhance Stones.
Yellow/Unique Gear can go to +15 then has 5 Amp levels.
Orange/Heroic Gear can go to +20 then has 5 amp levels. The % for success “soft resets” back to 60% from +15 to +16.

The +15 to +16 soft reset to 60% belongs to the Enhance transition described above. The next image is a separate +20 amplification example; its 25.5% sample chance is 16.5% + 9%, and a failure adds 3.0% in that example. No complete rate schedule is supplied.
Additional Notes
: Enhance Stones bottleneck for players who swipe
The paired Enhance crops show 250 stones required with 8.3K held as an approximate reading of an unlabeled material display, and 6,250 Kinah on the action button. These are sample values.

The paired Amplified Enhance crops show 15 stones required with 41 owned as an approximate reading of an unlabeled material display, and 2,000,000 Kinah on the action button. The sample level is not identified.

title: Potential enhancement
summary: Potential lines, regional crafted gear limits, tier progression and examples.

Captured update: 9/20/2026. Regional and screenshot-specific values are qualified in the text and image legends.

content.text: Potential
Enhance

Potential Enhance is a system that adds PVE Damage Boost/Tolerance on gear. Crafted gear automatically gets max Potential Stats and nearly double the value compared to Dungeon gear only on the Asian servers, this is not the case on the Global servers. It is not confirmed whether or not Crafted Potential Stats are higher than Dungeon Gear on Global yet. This is explained in
Further Detail
here
The automatically maximized, nearly doubled crafted Potential comparison is limited to Asian servers. Crafted versus dungeon Potential values on Global are not confirmed in the source.

In order to Potential Enhance your gear, you’ll need Potential Enhancement Material. This is obtained by Substance Morphing gear into Potential Stones. Potential Stones have Tiers and the Item Level of the gear you Substance Morph will determine the Tier. Currently Potential Stones go from 1* to 5* then to 1* “prestiged”

Aside from making this overly complicated, the system is pretty simple - you can convert extra gear into Potential Stones of the equal tier and use it to increase your Damage Boost/Tolerance on an exclusive “Potential” line
The accessory Potential Stone tooltip visibly has five stars. It does not show the later one-star “prestiged” tier described in the source.

title: Manastones and Soulstones
summary: Manastone and Soulstone line rolls, grade probabilities and replacement advice.

Captured update: 9/20/2026. Regional and screenshot-specific values are qualified in the text and image legends.

content.text: B - MANASTONE/SOULSTONE LINES

Manastones/Soulstones are items that you’ll use on your gear for RNG stats. Manastones are for Weapons and Armor, Soulstones are for Accessories. Every time you consume a single stone, you’ll roll random lines on all your Manastone/Soulstone sockets, in the case of the image below, 5 lines.
You’ll be wanting to roll Superiors on end-game gear. Do not waste too many of these, if at all, on gear you’ll replace soon.

Superior Manastone names the consumable, while its tooltip category reads Common Manastone. The roll-quality tabs are Basic green 50%, Superior blue 35%, and Ultimate yellow 15%. Yellow/unique stat-line wording describes the resulting lines, not the consumable category.

Try to roll at least 1 yellow Damage Boost stat from below. There is a big jump from blue (30) to yellow Boost (100). 100 Boost = 1% of that stat on your stat sheet, IE: Gold Weapon Damage Boost +100 = 1% Weapon Damage Boost.
Having 2 yellow/unique Attack lines is similar to 1 yellow/unique Damage Boost line
A single yellow/unique Attack (10) line is a decent placeholder roll if you are low on Stones.
Order from best to worst:
Front/Back Damage Boost > Weapon Damage Boost ≈ Critical Damage Boost > Damage Boost > Attack

Yellow Boost +100 and Attack +10 are visible examples. Blue Boost +30 and 100 Boost = 1% come from the source prose. Two yellow Attack lines ≈ one yellow Damage Boost line is Kanon’s comparison, not a conversion rule.
Manastones/Soulstones do not carry over when you transfer/upgrade gear so don’t go all-in on gear that’s replaced. Superior Mana/Soulstones get very expensive.

content.text: C - THEOSTONES

Theostones are items you socket into your weapons. You can socket 1 per item and the same Theostones do not stack. Theostones have a % chance to proc on hit with effects ranging from CC to Damage. General rule of thumb, the higher the Combat Speed netting you more hits, the more value lower % Theostones become. Keep in mind ping impacts this.

Theostones make up for very little overall DPS, even with yellow (highest grade) Theostones. Until this get’s buffed, it’s insignificant in PVE…some people actually just take the coolest looking Theostone considering Theostones give a glow effect on your weapon. The glow below is from the Earth Theostone.

content.text: D - SOUL BINDING

Soul Binding is a very simple enhancing system that is unnecessarily confusing at first because of the names. There are 3 different types of Soul Binding - Bind, Sync, and Reset. Soul Binding is relative to your
Stat Lines.
The source screenshot marks Bind with a yellow box, Sync with a purple box, and Reset with a green box. These are annotations around controls, not numeric stat grades.
Bind
“Bind” increases the blue Soul Binding Rate bar that increases the effectiveness of each
Stat Line

indicated by the yellow bar. The Blue Soul Binding Rate bar will be 100% when all the yellow lines are 100%. You’ll use Soul Codex books to enhance these. The cost for the books raise each time you enhance. An upgrade is guaranteed but the amount is RNG.
After reaching 100% Soul Binding Rate, you’ll be able to add an additional
Stat Line
by using 2 Philosopher’s Stones (obtained mainly from Conquest Dungeons).
Important: This extra
Stat Line
will not transfer over when transferring gear

Figures 042 and 043 are separate source placements of the same artwork. Six yellow original lines show 100%; a seventh purple Multi-hit Chance line is at 32% with 11.37%/12.54% shown. The aggregate displays 90.2% at this later stage. No averaging formula is given. Soul Codex 540 is inventory, not the per-action book cost.
The tooltip shows 12 stones in inventory. The requirement to add a stat line is 2 Philosopher’s Stones from the source prose.
Sync & Reset
Sync is how you reroll your
Stat Lines.
Reset is shuffling all of your
Stat Lines
at once. Full breakdown provided in
Chapter 3 - Guide: Ideal Stat Lines

title: Gear transfer and material costs
summary: Gear transfer direction, donor consumption, stone recipes and material costs.
qualifiers: The source recommendations and first-person statements are Kanon’s; screenshots are examples from the captured guide.
Captured update: 9/20/2026. Regional and screenshot-specific values are qualified in the text and image legends.

content.text: E - Transfer
Transfer allows you to transfer your gear to another, hopefully upgraded, piece of gear (notice the extra line from the Philosopher’s says it cannot transfer)

Transfer moves from the right donor to the left recipient. The donor is consumed on success; equipped and Preset gear cannot be used. The left-side values in figures 046 and 052 are the recipient’s existing stats, not a post-transfer result. The dim added donor line says Cannot Transfer.

Transferring cost “Transfer Stones.” These are obtained by Substance Morphing Transfer Stone Fragments. Other than select shops (such as Season Shop), Transfer Stone Fragments can only be obtained by Substance Morphing Orange/Heroic grade gear. 1 Heroic Gear = 5 Fragments
10 fragments (2 Heroics) = 1 Transfer Stone Accessory
15 fragments (3 Heroics) = 1 Transfer Stone Armor
20 fragments (4 Heroics) = 1 Transfer Stone Weapon

In the first pair, figure 049 is the fragment input → figure 048 is the completed Armor Transfer Stone output: 15 Heroic fragments are required, and 20/15 shows held/required. In the second pair, figure 051 is Heroic gear input → figure 050 is fragment output: each pictured gear tile yields five fragments.

When Transfering Yellow/Unique gear to Orange/Heroic, 5 additional yellow Transfer Stones are required. When transferring an item of the same grade (Yellow to yellow, orange to orange), 1 Transfer Stone of the same grade is required.

The “Heroic << Unique Gear Transfer Successes: 5” status is separate from the material row. The image supports one Heroic stone required, 0 held; and five Unique stones required, 3 held. A same-grade transfer uses one matching-grade stone.

Yellow/Unique Transfer Stones are obtained the same way as Orange/Heroics but be mindful of the Yellow/Unique gear you turn into Transfer Fragments. The x1 - x5 blue number represents how many Fragments you get from that piece. The higher the Item Level, the more Fragments you get.

Cyan x1–x5 on the Unique gear tiles are fragment yields. The prose says higher Item Level yields more fragments, but the image gives no numeric Item Level thresholds. The preceding Heroic-only wording is preserved alongside this later Unique-gear explanation.
Important
: Be frugal with Orange/Heroic Transfer Stones/Fragments. These are not
THAT easy
come across, if you save thes
e early on you’ll have a nice supply for later gear

. Orange/Heroic gear is MUCH more difficult and expensive to upgrade altogether so be sure to only transfer when you’re ready. I personally recommend not transferring or using the first Heroic Set (Ancient Spirit) and wait for the second set before going Orange/Heroic (Faded Shadow) unless additional changes are made to the game. Currently you can NOT upgrade a Yellow/Unique Transfer stone to an Orange/Heroic one. Transferring and Rolling lines on Yellow/Unique is free compared to Orange/Heroic). You need a LOT of Orange/Heroic Transfer Fragments for the future so just horde them early on.
